seo.title: Factors of 72 Speed Grid - Highly Composite Divisors Challenge
seo.metaDescription: Find all 12 factors of 72 on a 10x10 math grid. Test advanced factor pairs, multiplication facts, and division speed for 4th and 5th graders.
seo.intro: Seventy-two is an abundant, highly composite number with prime factorization 2^3 x 3^2. It has 12 distinct factors: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12, 18, 24, 36, and 72. Its factor pairs are (1, 72), (2, 36), (3, 24), (4, 18), (6, 12), and (8, 9). Identifying these 12 factors on a 100-tile board represents a pinnacle of elementary factor fluency.
seo.howToPlay: Scan the grid to click all 12 factors of 72. Correct numbers turn green with a checkmark. Distractor clicks flash red and penalize 2 seconds from the clock. Find all 12 factors to complete the challenge.
seo.teacherNotes: Note how factor pairs converge toward the square root: the closest pair is 8 and 9, right beside the square root of 72 (~8.48).
